about.title: About Illumineer’s Quest: The Great Hunny Rescue
paragraphs: Illumineer’s Quest: The Great Hunny Rescue is a Disney Lorcana co-operative boxed game, released on 2 October 2026. Its checklist has the 37 cards numbered 1/37 to 37/37.

The box also has 4 bonus cards numbered in booster sets, so they’re in those sets’ checklists: Sven - Leaping Reindeer (Winterspell 243/204), Christopher Robin - Hunny Sage (Attack of the Vine! 246/207), Mr. Incredible - Super Strong (Wilds Unknown 243/204) and Violet Parr - Super Resilient (Attack of the Vine! 247/207).
This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
